title: Federal Open Market Committee announces approval of updates to its Statement on Longer-Run Goals and Monetary Policy Strategy
summary: The FOMC unanimously approved updates to its Statement on Longer-Run Goals and Monetary Policy Strategy on August 22, 2025, marking the third iteration of the framework first adopted in 2012. The update reflects lessons from the past five years and is intended to enhance transparency, accountability, and effectiveness. Notably, the Committee's 2% longer-run inflation goal was not a focus of this review.
key_points: The FOMC unanimously approved updates to its Statement on Longer-Run Goals and Monetary Policy Strategy on August 22, 2025
This represents the third iteration of the framework, originally adopted in 2012, with prior reviews in 2019-20
The 2025 review process included Fed Listens events at Reserve Banks and a research conference held in May 2025
The 2% longer-run inflation goal was not a focus of the review
The statement describes the Committee's approach to promoting maximum employment and stable prices
The announced November 2024 review concluded with this update

It represents the Fed's strategic philosophy rather than near-term policy signals.
